001-empty-manifest.json.note: No owner_tag and no entries: the state before anything was installed.

002-claude-hooks-edit-span.json.note: Claude hooks inserted into settings.json by an edit_span with a backup.

003-claude-hooks-create-file.json.note: Claude hooks written to a settings file the installer created.

004-claude-statusline-edit-span.json.note: The Claude status line wrap, a separate consent edited into the same settings.json.

005-codex-hooks-edit-span-pending.json.note: Codex hooks edited into an existing file and waiting for review in /hooks.

006-codex-hooks-edit-span-installed.json.note: Codex hooks edited into an existing file and already trusted.

007-codex-hooks-create-file-pending.json.note: Codex hooks in a file the installer created, waiting for review.

008-codex-hooks-create-file-installed.js.note: Codex hooks in a file the installer created, already trusted.

009-opencode-plugin-create-file.json.note: The OpenCode plugin file created by the installer.

010-gemini-hooks-edit-span.json.note: Gemini hooks inserted into an existing settings file.

011-gemini-hooks-create-file.json.note: Gemini hooks in a settings file the installer created.

012-cursor-hooks-edit-span.json.note: Cursor hooks inserted into an existing hooks file.

013-cursor-hooks-create-file.json.note: Cursor hooks in a hooks file the installer created.

014-shim-binary-create-file.json.note: The shared shim binary, which has no tool and no owned list.

015-shim-binary-windows-path.json.note: The shim binary at a Windows drive path, with no tool.

016-windows-drive-claude-hooks.json.note: Claude hooks in settings.json at a Windows drive path.

017-windows-drive-opencode-plugin.json.note: The OpenCode plugin file at a Windows drive path.

021-before-bytes-zero.json.note: An existing file that was empty before the install.

022-before-bytes-max.json.note: An existing file at the 256 MiB size limit.

023-after-bytes-zero.json.note: A file whose size after the install is 0 bytes.

024-after-bytes-max.json.note: A file at the 256 MiB size limit after the install.

027-owned-64-items.json.note: An entry with the maximum of 64 owned items.

029-claude-hooks-and-statusline-same-fil.note: Two separate consents edit the same settings.json and both are listed.

030-mixed-realistic-manifest.json.note: A realistic set: Claude hooks, Codex pending review, the OpenCode plugin and the shim.

031-id-min-length.json.note: An entry id of the minimum two characters.

032-id-max-length.json.note: An entry id of the maximum 48 characters.

033-path-1024-chars.json.note: An absolute path of exactly 1024 characters.

034-path-non-ascii-spaces.json.note: A POSIX path with spaces and non-ASCII letters in the user folder.

035-owned-pointer-root-slash.json.note: An owned pointer of just a slash, which is valid RFC 6901 syntax.

036-owned-pointer-escaped-segment.json.note: An owned pointer with an escaped slash segment (~1).

037-owned-pointer-256-chars.json.note: An owned pointer of exactly 256 characters.

038-owner-tag-16-chars-alt.json.note: An owner_tag of exactly 16 lowercase characters, the shortest legal length.

039-owner-tag-digits-only.json.note: An owner_tag made only of digits, which the pattern allows.

040-owner-tag-32-chars.json.note: An owner_tag of exactly 32 characters, the longest legal length.

041-owned-statusline-wrap-replaced-sha25.note: The statusLine wrap: an owned item with a null event that replaced an existing value.

042-codex-hooks-create-file-two-owned.js.note: Codex hooks in a created file with two owned items for two different events.

043-owned-two-items-claude-hooks.json.note: Claude hooks with two owned items in one entry, one per hook event.

044-owned-event-max-length.json.note: An owned event of the maximum 64 characters.

045-owned-event-with-dot.json.note: An owned event name containing a dot, which the pattern allows.

046-owned-replaced-value-on-hook-event.j.note: An owned hook item that also replaced an earlier value, so replaced_sha256 is set on a named event.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-leftover-receiver-field.json.note: The receiver field was removed in r1, so a leftover receiver is an unknown root field.

005-missing-entries.json.note: entries is required (an empty array when nothing is installed).

006-missing-owner-tag.json.note: owner_tag is required, and null is allowed only with an empty entries array.

007-unknown-root-field.json.note: An unknown top-level field is rejected.

008-schema-version-2.json.note: schema_version must be 1 for this contract.

009-owner-tag-null-with-entries.json.note: owner_tag may be null only while entries is empty.

010-owner-tag-uppercase.json.note: owner_tag must be lowercase letters and digits.

011-owner-tag-15-chars.json.note: owner_tag of 15 characters is below the minimum of 16.

012-owner-tag-33-chars.json.note: owner_tag of 33 characters is above the maximum of 32.

013-owner-tag-with-dash.json.note: owner_tag may not contain a dash.

017-entry-id-uppercase.json.note: An entry id must be lowercase.

018-entry-id-leading-digit.json.note: An entry id must start with a letter.

019-entry-id-one-char.json.note: An entry id needs at least two characters.

020-entry-id-49-chars.json.note: An entry id over 48 characters is rejected.

021-unknown-target.json.note: target must be one of the defined targets.

022-tool-other.json.note: The tool other is not allowed in this contract.

023-tool-unknown-name.json.note: The tool copilot is not a known agent.

024-claude-hooks-with-codex.json.note: claude_hooks must serve the claude tool.

025-shim-binary-with-tool.json.note: shim_binary must have a null tool because several agents share it.

026-non-shim-null-tool.json.note: A non-shim target must name its tool, not null.

027-opencode-plugin-edit-span.json.note: opencode_plugin must be create_file, not edit_span.

028-shim-binary-edit-span.json.note: shim_binary must be create_file, not edit_span.

029-claude-hooks-without-owned.json.note: A claude_hooks entry must list its owned items, and this one does not.

030-codex-hooks-create-file-without-owne.note: A codex_hooks entry must list its owned items even when the file was created.

031-opencode-plugin-with-owned.json.note: opencode_plugin is a whole file Busyholm owns, so it may not carry owned.

032-shim-binary-with-owned.json.note: shim_binary is a whole file Busyholm owns, so it may not carry owned.

033-owned-empty-array.json.note: An owned list may not be empty, since a config entry always lists at least one item.

034-owned-missing-replaced-sha256.json.note: An owned item must always carry replaced_sha256, null or a hash.

035-owned-item-unknown-key.json.note: An owned item is a closed object, so a note key is rejected.

036-owned-event-with-space.json.note: An owned event must match the identifier pattern, so a space is rejected.

037-leftover-edits-field.json.note: The edits field was replaced by owned in r1, so a leftover edits key is an unknown entry field.

038-owned-over-64.json.note: An owned list may hold at most 64 items.

039-owned-pointer-no-leading-slash.json.note: An owned pointer must start with a slash.

040-owned-pointer-257-chars.json.note: An owned pointer over 256 characters is rejected.

041-owned-sha256-uppercase.json.note: An owned sha256 must be lowercase hex.

044-before-existed-true-sha256-null.json.note: A file that existed needs its sha256.

045-before-existed-false-sha256-set.json.note: A file that did not exist has a null sha256.

046-before-existed-false-bytes-set.json.note: A file that did not exist has null bytes.

047-pending-review-on-claude.json.note: pending_review is only for Codex hooks.

048-codex-state-failed.json.note: The state must be installed or pending_review.

049-path-relative.json.note: A path must be absolute, so a relative path is rejected.

050-path-unc.json.note: UNC paths are rejected on purpose.

051-path-control-char.json.note: A path may not contain a control character.

052-path-over-1024-chars.json.note: A path over 1024 characters is rejected.

053-path-drive-forward-slash.json.note: A Windows drive path must use a backslash after the drive letter.

054-after-sha256-uppercase.json.note: A sha256 must be lowercase hex.

055-after-sha256-63-chars.json.note: A sha256 must be exactly 64 characters.

056-before-sha256-63-chars.json.note: A before sha256 must be exactly 64 characters.

058-after-bytes-negative.json.note: A size in bytes may not be negative.

059-installed-at-seconds.json.note: installed_at in seconds is below the millisecond range.

061-installed-at-iso-string.json.note: installed_at must be an integer, not an ISO string.

063-duplicate-entry-id.json.note: Entry ids are unique across the array.

064-duplicate-target-path.json.note: The same target and path may not appear twice.

065-entry-unknown-field.json.note: An unknown field in an entry (a note) is rejected.

067-entry-state-pending.json.note: The state must be installed or pending_review, so the value pending is rejected.

068-entry-action-delete.json.note: The action must be edit_span or create_file.
